description: System: the Ubuntu/K3s VM. Cluster: global Kubernetes and collection health. Workloads: Deployment Pods selected by namespace and Deployment. Missing data remains visible; resource and readiness metrics do not prove media playback.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Ubuntu/K3s VM, not the underlying Proxmox host. CPU is averaged over the rate window; memory is total minus available.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Ubuntu/K3s VM, not the underlying Proxmox host. CPU is averaged over the rate window; memory is total minus available.

panels.title: Root disk available
panels.description: Space available on the shared VM filesystem. A local-path PVC request is not a filesystem quota.

panels.title: Network collector
panels.description: Collector success is separate from scrape health. Missing or renamed ens18 can still leave the traffic panel without data.

panels.title: CPU · busy over time
panels.description: Percentage of all VM CPU capacity in use; the rate window adapts to chart resolution.

panels.title: Memory · used over time
panels.description: 100 × (1 − available / total). Available memory includes reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Network · ens18
panels.description: Bytes per second at the VM interface. Receive and transmit are both positive; this is not per-application traffic.

targets.expr: (up{job="prometheus"} or (absent(up{job="prometheus"}) * -1)) or (up{job="node-exporter"} or (absent(up{job="node-exporter"}) * -1)) or (up{job="node-exporter-network"} or (absent(up{job="node-exporter-network"}) * -1)) or (up{job="kube-state-metrics"} or (absent(up{job="kube-state-metrics"}) * -1)) or (up{job="kubelet-resource"} or (absent(up{job="kubelet-resource"}) * -1))

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Five expected targets. Up = scrape succeeded; Down = scrape failed; Missing = expected target has no current series. This does not prove application behavior.

panels.title: Node Ready
panels.description: Kubernetes Ready condition; a missing measurement stays No data.

panels.title: Node pressure
panels.description: Reports whether memory, disk or PID pressure is currently asserted. Also inspect Node Ready and scrape health.

panels.title: PVCs · bound / total
panels.description: Binding state across all namespaces. Bound does not prove filesystem free space, application integrity or backup coverage.

panels.title: Deployment replicas · cluster
panels.description: All namespaces, independent of workload filters. Deployment replicas only; DaemonSets and StatefulSets are not counted.

panels.title: PVC binding · all namespaces
panels.description: Current binding state for each claim. No data is not treated as a healthy zero.

panels.title: Deployment replicas · selected
panels.description: Desired versus available replicas for the selected Deployments. Namespace and Deployment filters apply here. ReplicaSet controller ownership selects Deployment Pods; standalone Pods, Jobs, DaemonSets and StatefulSets are outside this section. Missing owner or consumption series stay missing.

targets.expr: (kube_pod_container_status_ready{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (deployment) (max by (namespace, pod, deployment) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name=~"${workload:regex}-[a-z0-9]+"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+")))

panels.title: Container readiness
panels.description: One current series per Pod/container. Ready does not prove playback, search or downloads. Namespace and Deployment filters apply here. ReplicaSet controller ownership selects Deployment Pods; standalone Pods, Jobs, DaemonSets and StatefulSets are outside this section. Missing owner or consumption series stay missing.

targets.expr: (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-resource",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (deployment) (max by (namespace, pod, deployment) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name=~"${workload:regex}-[a-z0-9]+"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+")))

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores consumed per container: 0.1 cores = 100 millicores. Not a percentage of the VM. Namespace and Deployment filters apply here. ReplicaSet controller ownership selects Deployment Pods; standalone Pods, Jobs, DaemonSets and StatefulSets are outside this section. Missing owner or consumption series stay missing.

targets.expr: (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet-resource",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (deployment) (max by (namespace, pod, deployment) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name=~"${workload:regex}-[a-z0-9]+"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+")))

panels.title: Container memory · working set
panels.description: Working-set memory, including some cache; not application heap alone. Namespace and Deployment filters apply here. ReplicaSet controller ownership selects Deployment Pods; standalone Pods, Jobs, DaemonSets and StatefulSets are outside this section. Missing owner or consumption series stay missing.

targets.expr: (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (deployment) (max by (namespace, pod, deployment) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name=~"${workload:regex}-[a-z0-9]+"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+")))

panels.title: Restarts · current Pods
panels.description: Cumulative restart count for each current Pod/container. A replacement Pod has a new identity and count. Namespace and Deployment filters apply here. ReplicaSet controller ownership selects Deployment Pods; standalone Pods, Jobs, DaemonSets and StatefulSets are outside this section. Missing owner or consumption series stay missing.

targets.expr: (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (deployment) (max by (namespace, pod, deployment) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{job="kube-state-metrics",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name=~"${workload:regex}-[a-z0-9]+"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+")))

panels.title: Restarts · selected time range
panels.description: Estimated increase over the dashboard time range for currently owned Pods. increase extrapolates and can be fractional; it does not count replacement Pods that have disappeared. Namespace and Deployment filters apply here. ReplicaSet controller ownership selects Deployment Pods; standalone Pods, Jobs, DaemonSets and StatefulSets are outside this section. Missing owner or consumption series stay missing.
